①Installed Applications/Packages. We do not share your primary account information with any third party. ③Crash Logs. We track and retain logs regarding crashes users experience while using the แอพคู่ขนาน. These logs contain information about the error types, timestamp that the error occurred, and general device information listed above. No personal information is stored in crash logs."
